mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, it is a clear 41 degrees out at Badger Prairie County Park. We have a First Quarter moon tonight, and the ISS will be visible rising over Cross Plains and traveling toward Madison near Home Depot. Expect an overnight low of 30 degrees with no rain in the forecast.
The Verona Park and Recreation Department is updating current power standings for local sports leagues, and City Hall has released several important notices regarding the November General Election.
There is plenty to do, with live music at Bailey's Run today, music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow as well.
In a report from October 25, officers arrested a man for an O W I after discovering him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor is Mint Explosion. The store is currently open until 10 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
